presentation_goal: 展示2026年线上运单1-8月实际与8-12月目标路径，并点明达成目标所需环比增速。
audience: 平台运营/业务负责人，需一眼看清现状缺口与后程增速压力。
theme_style: Clean business, light gray content bg, navy header, orange accent for target gap.

visual_system.background_strategy: Content page light rgba(248,249,251); navy header bar; orange left accent.
visual_system.motif: Left orange accent + navy header strip + right insight panel.

color_roles.primary: Navy rgb(15,30,58) for structure and actual series
color_roles.secondary: Light card white for chart panel
color_roles.accent: Orange rgb(240,129,54) for target series and key callouts

typography_constraints.long_text_handling: Keep insight bullets short; put caveat in footer.

slides.title: 线上整体运单：实际 vs 目标
slides.key_message: 1-7月已放量至30.1万单；8月MTD16.5万，距月目标35.2万仍有缺口；8-12目标路径要求月环比约+17%~+40%。
slides.visual_focus: Large dual-series line chart (actual 1-8, target 8-12) occupying left-center; right insight panel with growth rates.

asset_need.purpose: Chart is native <chart> element; no external image.
asset_need.fallback_if_missing: Use whiteboard SVG line if chart fails.

slides.speaker_intent: 先讲放量路径，再讲8月MTD缺口，最后落到8→12目标环比增速要求。
